notes.title: Demo Update - 1.2
notes.notes:
🎯 Added new tower targeting options! These include:

📈 Progress / First

⏪ Last

🛡️ Most Armor

🔮 Most Magic Armor

❤️ Highest HP

🩹 Least HP

🐢 Slowest

⚡ Fastest

🖥️ Some minor UI/UX enhancements throughout the game

✨ Fixed overlay and VFX issues when playing multiple enchant cards in succession

notes.title: Demo 1.1 Update
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the card unlock system was not working properly, preventing players from correctly unlocking new cards.
